Metadata.title: Untungin — Calculate COGS & Business Profit
Metadata.description: Calculate COGS, selling prices, operating costs, and your business profit with ease.

Landing.heading: Know whether your business makes money from day one.
Landing.intro: Calculate COGS from ingredients, operating costs, and equipment depreciation. Get the right selling price and see when you'll earn your capital back — no accounting knowledge needed.

hpp.title: Automatic COGS
hpp.body: Enter ingredients and amounts; the cost per portion is calculated instantly.

price.title: The right price
price.body: Price suggestions for your target margin, including GoFood & marketplace fees.

profit.title: Profit & payback
profit.body: See monthly profit, daily sales targets, and when your capital comes back.
